text:
maria_support: customer (ACME Inc) reports repeated invoice payment failures when users try to authenticate 3DS in our embedded iframe. They see the bank auth page load briefly then the iframe goes blank / times out. Multiple cards and browsers (Safari iOS, Chrome desktop) but highest reported on Safari iOS. Customer provided screenshot and session id.

jon_engineer: thanks — can you paste the payment intent id and any gateway logs? also which integration flow are they using (iframe vs hosted redirect)?

maria_support: using our iframe checkout (v2) embedded on /checkout. PaymentIntent: pi_01H8Y2Xx6uXcD2Lq. Error from gateway in our logs: "authentication_failed: redirect failed (iframe_load_timeout)". Customer says spinner shows for ~20s then blank. Tried clearing cookies, same result.

sam_oncall: quick check — we rolled out iframe CSP tightening on 2026-03-10 (deploy dpl-20260310-iframe). Could be related if bank pages rely on window.postMessage or third-party cookies. Maria, can you confirm if iframe is cross-origin and if we changed any SameSite or x-frame headers?

maria_support: confirmed iframe is cross-origin. I checked headers captured from the client session: our response from /embed has: 
```
Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' https://acme-app.com
Set-Cookie: session=abc; SameSite=Lax
X-Frame-Options: ALLOW-FROM https://bank-auth.example
```
But the gateway redirect URL responds with 200 then quickly 502 inside iframe per our network logs.

jon_engineer: could be two things: 1) banks that require top-level redirect vs iframe (Safari blocks third-party cookies/requests inside iframes), 2) our CSP or SameSite changes preventing the bank from finishing the auth handshake. Can you attach the raw gateway webhook payload we got for pi_01H8Y2Xx6uXcD2Lq? Also any client console errors from the user's session (CSP violations, blocked cookies)?

maria_support: attaching snippet from our billing backend (redacted):
```
{"event":"invoice_payment_failed","invoice_id":"inv_2026_98765","pi":"pi_01H8Y2Xx6uXcD2Lq","reason":"authentication_required","gateway":"acme-gateway","gateway_response":"3ds_failed","gateway_code":"iframe_timeout","notes":"iframe 3ds load timeout after 18s; user reported blank iframe"}
```
Client console (customer): "Blocked a frame with origin https://bank-auth.example from accessing a cross-origin frame." and several "Third-party cookie blocked" warnings.

sam_oncall: can you reproduce with Safari iOS simulator? If Safari blocks third-party cookies in iframes by default, some banks expect top-level redirect to complete SCA. Workaround: trigger a hosted redirect flow (open bank page in top-level) instead of embedding — can we offer that to the merchant for affected invoices?

iris_pm: marking this P2 but high customer impact. We should: 1) provide a workaround to ACME (hosted redirect link or ask user to open in new tab), 2) add telemetry to detect 'iframe 3ds timeouts' automatically, 3) consider reverting the CSP/SameSite tightening if it broke widespread banks. Assign to eng-infra and payments infra.

jon_engineer: I dug into our recent deploy notes — the SameSite=Lax to Lax change was intentional, but we also set X-Frame-Options: ALLOW-FROM for specific origins. Some banks set frame-ancestors CSP that conflicts. I'll add a quick check in payments proxy to detect 3DS redirect domains and force 'top-level' flow for known problematic banks.

billing_bot: [automated] invoice_payment_failed recorded: invoice_id=inv_2026_98765, customer=ACME Inc, reason=authentication_failed, gateway_code=iframe_timeout, occurrences=3

maria_support: I told ACME support: please try opening the auth page in a new tab when prompted (works around Safari iframe cookie restrictions). Also offered to switch their integration to hosted redirect temporarily. Customer accepted hosted redirect for now and wants root cause.

jon_engineer: next steps for eng: (1) add detection + automatic fallback to hosted redirect for iframe 3DS timeouts (2) add logging to surface blocked third-party cookie / CSP violations to the payment trace (3) create a runbook for support with suggested customer workarounds.

sam_oncall: I'll open an incident ticket and tag payments-infra, assign to @jon_engineer and set SLA 72h. If we see >5 customers in next 48h, escalate to P1.

iris_pm: thanks team — Maria, keep the customer updated and collect additional session ids. Jon/Sam, please post a short summary in #eng-releases once a mitigation is live. :thumbsup:

maria_support: noted — sending ACME a hosted-checkout link and capturing their session ids for next 24h. Will update thread when they confirm payment succeeded or if issue persists."
